name: doodle
label: Doodle
css: .style-doodle { --slide-primary: #49B6E5; --slide-secondary: #263D5B; --slide-success: #16A34A; --slide-warning: #D97706; --slide-danger: #DC2626; --slide-surface: #FFFFFF; --slide-text: #111827; --slide-spacing-4: 4px; --slide-spacing-8: 8px; --slide-spacing-12: 12px; --slide-spacing-16: 16px; --slide-spacing-24: 24px; --slide-spacing-32: 32px; position: relative; width: 1080px; height: 1080px; background: var(--slide-surface); padding: var(--slide-spacing-32); display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; font-family: 'Delius Swash Caps', cursive; overflow: hidden; } .style-doodle::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: -20%; right: -10%; width: 400px; height: 400px; background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(73, 182, 229, 0.08) 0%, transparent 70%); border-radius: 50%; pointer-events: none; transform: rotate(-15deg); } .style-doodle .hook { font-family: 'Delius Swash Caps', cursive; font-size: 80px; font-weight: 900; color: var(--slide-text); line-height: 1.1; letter-spacing: -1px; margin: 0; max-width: 90%; word-wrap: break-word; text-shadow: 2px 2px 0px rgba(73, 182, 229, 0.15); } .style-doodle .text { font-family: 'Delius Swash Caps', cursive; font-size: 50px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--slide-secondary); line-height: 1.3; margin: 0; max-width: 85%; word-wrap: break-word; } .style-doodle .step { position: absolute; top: var(--slide-spacing-32); right: var(--slide-spacing-32); font-family: 'Delius Swash Caps', cursive; font-size: 160px; font-weight: 900; color: var(--slide-text); opacity: 0.12; line-height: 1; } .style-doodle .brand { position: absolute; bottom: var(--slide-spacing-16); left: var(--slide-spacing-32); font-family: 'Delius Swash Caps', cursive; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--slide-primary); letter-spacing: 0.5px; } .slide-code.style-doodle { --slide-surface: #1F2937; --slide-text: #F3F4F6; --slide-secondary: #E5E7EB; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1F2937 0%, #111827 100%); } .slide-code.style-doodle .hook { color: #F0F9FF; text-shadow: 2px 2px 0px rgba(73, 182, 229, 0.25); } .slide-code.style-doodle .text { color: #DBEAFE; } .slide-code.style-doodle .brand { color: #7DD3FC; } .slide-code.style-doodle::before { background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(73, 182, 229, 0.15) 0%, transparent 70%); } .slide-insight.style-doodle { --slide-surface: #0F172A; --slide-text: #F8FAFC; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0F172A 0%, #1E293B 100%); } .slide-insight.style-doodle .hook { color: #F0F9FF; text-shadow: 2px 2px 0px rgba(73, 182, 229, 0.3); } .slide-insight.style-doodle .text { color: #BFDBFE; } .slide-insight.style-doodle .insight-text { font-family: 'Delius Swash Caps', cursive; font-size: 48px; font-weight: 600; color: #F0F9FF; line-height: 1.4; margin: var(--slide-spacing-24) 0; max-width: 90%; } .slide-insight.style-doodle .brand { color: #38BDF8; } .slide-insight.style-doodle::before { background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(73, 182, 229, 0.2) 0%, transparent 70%); }
